name: Sai Krishna Vala
headline: Dynamics 365 & Power Platform
summary: Around five years of Dynamics 365 and Power Platform experience, combining requirements analysis, hands-on development and collaboration with stakeholders, clients and development teams.

lead: Coordinate work across four applications using Power Apps and Dynamics CRM.
Work across the sales and hiring domains while translating stakeholder requirements into technical work.
Take on product ownership responsibilities and coordinate delivery with the team.
tech: Built the core Field Service domain and Power Pages experiences.
Built Power Automate flows, C# plugins and PCF controls.
Connect requirements, process design and implementation across the applications.
roles.problem: Sales and hiring work needed product ownership that could turn stakeholder needs into coordinated technical delivery.
roles.approach: Coordinate the work, translate requirements into technical changes, and build the Field Service, Power Pages, automation, plugin and PCF pieces needed by the applications.
roles.result: A connected delivery approach across the sales and hiring domains.

lead: Worked with the team on Dynamics 365 Sales.
Co-built Customer Service, Power Pages and Field Service solutions.
Collaborated with the team to connect the customer-facing portal and internal CRM service process.
tech: Co-built a Power Pages experience where customers could sign in, view relevant products and create requests.
Connected requests to Customer Service cases and supported Field Service scheduling and technician assignment when a visit was needed.
Recorded service feedback in Customer Service and supported sales follow-up actions and sequences.
roles.problem: Customers needed a way to view relevant products and create service requests without losing the connection to the internal service process.
roles.approach: Co-build a Power Pages, Customer Service and Field Service experience with the Lululemon team, including requests, cases, scheduling, surveys and sales follow-up context.
roles.result: A connected service flow from customer sign-in through service feedback and sales follow-up.
